verdict.rationale: First-party docs state directly that Crawl4AI has adaptive crawling that 'knows when to stop', using information-foraging algorithms to decide when enough information has been gathered to answer the query. This matches the story's core. The evidence is a single high-level marketing statement, though. Missing for 10: documentation of the adaptive-crawl API and configuration (stopping thresholds, confidence or coverage metrics, how the query is supplied), and independent or hands-on confirmation that it stops reliably at scale.
